newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Mobutu convoy arrives in Zaire capital - officials.
newsitem.headline: Mobutu convoy arrives in Zaire capital - officials.

text.p: Zaire's ailing and embattled President Mobutu Sese Seko arrived in the capital Kinshasa on Saturday, officials at the president's office said.
"Mobutu has returned and landed at around 2.05 p.m. (1305 GMT)," one official said.
His motorcade, under heavily armed guard, was seen heading towards his residence in Kinshasa, witnesses said.
Mobutu, at a meeting with South African Deputy President Thabo Mbeki in Gabon, earlier agreed to talks with rebel leader Laurent Kabila on Wednesday.
